arxiv-1904-12271.title: X-Ray Image Compression Using Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks Thanks:
arxiv-1904-12271.creator: Asif Shahriyar Sushmit, Shakib Uz Zaman, Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun, Taufiq Hasan, and Mohammed Imamul Hassan Bhuiyan
arxiv-1904-12271.description: Abstract In the advent of a digital health revolution, vast amounts of clinical data are being generated, stored and processed on a daily basis. This has made the storage and retrieval of large volumes of health-care data, especially, high-resolution medical images, particularly challenging.

arxiv-2208-01127.title: Disparate Censorship & Undertesting: A Source of Label Bias in Clinical Machine Learning
arxiv-2208-01127.creator: Trenton Chang, Michael W. Sjoding, Jenna Wiens
arxiv-2208-01127.description: Abstract As machine learning (ML) models gain traction in clinical applications, understanding the impact of clinician and societal biases on ML models is increasingly important. While biases can arise in the labels used for model training, the many sources from which these biases arise are not yet well-studied. In this paper, we highlight disparate censorship ( i.e.

arxiv-2208-08843.title: Catastrophic Dark Matter Particle Capture
arxiv-2208-08843.creator: Ruth Durrer, Serge Parnovsky
arxiv-2208-08843.description: Abstract In this paper we describe a new idea which may be relevant to the formation of galaxies via the infall of baryonic matter (BM) and dark matter (DM) onto a pre-existing over density. While BM can under certain circumstances be captured by thermal processes, DM particles fly through a static over density without being captured.

arxiv-2307-00948.title: Dual formulation of constraint solutions for the multi-state Choquard equation
arxiv-2307-00948.creator: Gershon Wolansky
arxiv-2307-00948.description: Abstract The Choquard equation is a partial differential equation that has gained significant interest and attention in recent decades. It is a nonlinear equation that combines elements of both the Laplace and Schrödinger operators, and it arises frequently in the study of numerous physical phenomena, from condensed matter physics to nonlinear optics.

arxiv-2310-10431.title: Longitudinal self-supervised learning using neural ordinary differential equation
arxiv-2310-10431.creator: Rachid Zeghlache, Pierre-Henri Conze, Mostafa El Habib Daho, Yihao Li, Hugo Le Boité, Ramin Tadayoni, Pascal Massin, Béatrice Cochener, Ikram Brahim, Gwenolé Quellec, Mathieu Lamard
arxiv-2310-10431.description: Abstract Longitudinal analysis in medical imaging is crucial to investigate the progressive changes in anatomical structures or disease progression over time. In recent years, a novel class of algorithms has emerged with the goal of learning disease progression in a self-supervised manner, using either pairs of consecutive images or time series of images.

arxiv-2311-11774.title: A simple consensus model for an increasing population of agents with i.i.d incoming opinions.
arxiv-2311-11774.creator: Ioannis Markou
arxiv-2311-11774.description: Abstract In this short note we study what happens in a symmetric opinion model when we send the total interacting population N ⁡ ( t ) N(t) to infinity as t → ∞ t\to\infty . We assume that new population enters the system with opinions that are i.i.d random vectors with finite mean and variance.

arxiv-2411-06838.title: Generalized Wasserstein Barycenters
arxiv-2411-06838.creator: Francesco Tornabene, Marco Veneroni, Giuseppe Savaré
arxiv-2411-06838.description: Abstract We study the existence and uniqueness of the barycenter of a signed distribution of probability measures on a Hilbert space. The barycenter is found, as usual, as a minimum of a functional. In the case where the positive part of the signed measure is atomic, we can show also uniqueness.

arxiv-2504-05656.title: Anti-pre-Novikov algebras, quasi-triangular and factorizable anti-pre-Novikov bialgebras
arxiv-2504-05656.creator: Qinxiu Sun, Xingyu Zeng
arxiv-2504-05656.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qinxiu Sun, Xingyu Zeng. Firstly, we introduce a notion of anti-pre-Novikov algebras as a new framework for decomposing Novikov algebras. Anti- 𝒪 \mathcal{O} -operators on Novikov algebras are developed to provide an algebraic framework for constructing anti-pre-Novikov algebras. Secondly, we introduce a notion of anti-pre-Novikov bialgebras as the bialgebra structures corresponding to a double construction of symmetric quasi-Frobenius Novikov algebras, which is characterized by certain matched pairs of Novikov algebras as well as the compatible anti-pre-Novikov algebras.

arxiv-2510-26726.title: Phantom types for robust hierarchical models with typegeist
arxiv-2510-26726.creator: Daniel O’Hanlon
arxiv-2510-26726.description: Abstract In Bayesian hierarchical models, group-level parameter arrays must be mapped to the observation axis, often using explicit indexing. In complex models with numerous incompatible data and parameter sets, this introduces the potential for bugs, as indexing with the incorrect indices typically fails silently.

arxiv-2511-02923.title: Cropland Mapping using Geospatial Embeddings
arxiv-2511-02923.creator: Ivan Zvonkov, Gabriel Tseng, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Hannah Kerner
arxiv-2511-02923.description: Abstract Accurate and up-to-date land cover maps are essential for understanding land use change, a key driver of climate change. Geospatial embeddings offer a more efficient and accessible way to map landscape features, yet their use in real-world mapping applications remains underexplored. In this work, we evaluated the utility of geospatial embeddings for cropland mapping in Togo.

arxiv-2512-20335.title: Status of the Muon g − 2 g\!-\!2 /EDM Experiment at J-PARC
arxiv-2512-20335.creator: Graziano Venanzoni
arxiv-2512-20335.description: Abstract The Muon g − 2 g\!-\!2 /EDM Experiment at J-PARC will employ a novel way to measure the muon magnetic anomaly, a μ = ( g − 2 ) μ / 2 a_{\mu}=(g-2)_{\mu}/2 , by using a low-emittance beam of positive muons stored in a compact muon storage magnet.

plos-pone-0010398.title: Cancer Reduces Transcriptome Specialization
plos-pone-0010398.creator: Octavio Martínez, M. Humberto Reyes-Valdés, Luis Herrera-Estrella
plos-pone-0010398.description: PLOS ONE research article. A central goal of cancer biology is to understand how cells from this family of genetic diseases undergo specific morphological and physiological changes and regress to a de-regulated state of the cell cycle. The fact that tumors are unable to perform most of the specific functio

pmc-10675685.title: Associations between High Protein Intake, Linear Growth, and Stunting in Children and Adolescents: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10675685.creator: Ting Xiong, Yuanjue Wu, Jiazhen Hu, Shiqi Xu, Yan Li, Binxuan Kong, Zhuangyu Zhang, Liangkai Chen, Yuhan Tang, Ping Yao, Jingfan Xiong, Yanyan Li, Josep A Tur
pmc-10675685.description: Background and aims: Childhood and adolescence are critical periods for linear growth and preventing stunting. Current evidence indicates that dietary protein intake in children and adolescents is often two to three times higher than the recommendations in many regions worldwide. However, few studies have focused on the association between high protein intake and linear growth and stunting in this population.

pmc-11446204.title: Insulin Resistance Surrogates May Predict HTN-HUA in Young, Non-Obese Individuals
pmc-11446204.creator: Yu-Qiang Zuo, Zhi-Hong Gao, Yu-Ling Yin, Xu Yang, Xing Guan, Ping-Yong Feng
pmc-11446204.description: ObjectiveTo compare the associations of three surrogate markers of insulin resistance (IR) [glucose and triglycerides (TyG index), TyG index with BMI (TyG-BMI), and the ratio of triglycerides divided by HDL-C (TG/HDL-C)] with hypertensive patients (HTN) plus hyperuricemia (HUA) (HTN-HUA) in young, non-obese individuals.

pmc-11693154.title: A QUALITATIVE EXPLORATION OF A PSYCHOSOCIAL INTERVENTION FOR LONELINESS AND SOCIAL ISOLATION IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11693154.creator: Max Zubatsky, Marla Berg-Weger, Dimitra Tziarli, Rachel Livingston, Jen Lauck
pmc-11693154.description: Loneliness and social isolation is a public health epidemic in older adults. Although providers are exploring more psychosocial interventions to help curb this trend in the community and healthcare settings, very few evidence-based approaches have been able to deliver effective interventions and strategies for this population.

pmc-11713777.title: Enhancing Dementia Care in Rural Communities: A Tele‐rehabilitative Approach through Community‐Centered Technology Integration
pmc-11713777.creator: Marguerite Corvini, Jing Wang, Sajay Arthanat
pmc-11713777.description: BackgroundResource‐constrained rural areas face significant challenges in providing access to healthcare resources, especially for older adults, including those living with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). We seek to address these gaps by equipping six rural community sites in New Hampshire and Maine with tele‐rehabilitative equipment.

pmc-12570708.title: Comparison of trabecular bone structure using fractal dimension analysis in patients undergoing lateral window and transcrestal sinus lift procedures: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12570708.creator: Hasan Akpınar, Furkan Ozbey, Betül Yıldırım
pmc-12570708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThis retrospective study evaluated alterations in trabecular bone structure after lateral window and transcrestal sinus floor elevation techniques using fractal analysis of panoramic radiographs, with a focus on comparing ossification patterns.Materials and methodsThis STROBE compliant retrospective radiographic cohort included 46 sinus lift procedures (transcrestal without graft: n = 21; lateral window with xenograft: n = 25) performed between 2020 and 2024. For each case, two panoramic radiographs were analyzed on the surgery week (T0) and at 6 months (T1) yielding 92 images.

pmc-12605103.title: Utility of bronchoalveolar lavage in checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis evaluation: a narrative review
pmc-12605103.creator: Senthuran Shivakumar, Sagun Parakh, Natalia Vukelic, Farzaneh Atashrazm, Vivek Naranbhai, Nicole Soo Leng Goh, Jessica Da Gama Duarte, Tracy Li-Tsein Leong
pmc-12605103.description: Background and ObjectiveCheckpoint inhibitors have revolutionised cancer treatment over the past few decades; however, their successes in clinical trials and real-world settings have been tempered by immune-related adverse events (IrAEs). Checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis (CIP), the leading cause of IrAE-related mortality, poses a significant challenge to clinicians due to non-specific clinical features and unpredictable disease trajectory.

pmc-12652617.title: Patient-Reported Outcomes on Quality of Life in Older Adults with Oral Pemphigus
pmc-12652617.creator: Emily-Alice Russu, Liliana Gabriela Popa, Stana Păunică, Lucia Bubulac, Călin Giurcăneanu, Cristina-Crenguța Albu, Matthew R Nangle
pmc-12652617.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Oral pemphigus is a rare autoimmune blistering disorder predominantly affecting the mucous membranes, particularly in older adults. Despite therapeutic advances, the chronic, painful, and recurrent nature of oral pemphigus vulgaris substantially impairs patients’ quality of life (QoL). Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) offer valuable insights into the subjective burden of the disease; however, data on PROs in older adults with oral pemphigus are scarce.

pmc-12681688.title: The Hidden Threat: Maxillary Hardware-Associated Actinomycosis in Diabetes
pmc-12681688.creator: Nidha Shapoo, Noella Boma
pmc-12681688.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Actinomycosis is a chronic granulomatous infection caused by anaerobic Gram-positive Actinomyces species. While cervicofacial actinomycosis is the most common form, involvement of the maxilla is rare due to its rich vascular supply. Osteomyelitis of the maxilla, caused by actinomycosis, is an uncommon but serious condition that can lead to extensive local destruction and soft tissue involvement in patients with implanted hardware and underlying immunocompromised state.

pmc-12710263.title: Posttraumatic stress disorder in serving Australian Defence Force members 2002–2023: a systematic evidence review
pmc-12710263.creator: Dunya Tomic, Jennifer Wild, Zoë Jenkins, Helen Kelsall, Natasha Kinsman, Alex Collie, Shanthakumar Wilson Rajaratnam, Karen Walker-Bone
pmc-12710263.description: Background: Defence forces globally face recruitment and retention challenges, with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) often contributing to early discharge.Objective: To systematically review the extent of research on PTSD among Australian Defence Force (ADF) members, focusing on epidemiology, comorbidities, screening tools, and treatment outcomes to establish the evidence base and inform longitudinal research over the life course.

pmc-12963403.title: DiNovo enables high-coverage and high-confidence de novo peptide sequencing via mirror proteases and deep learning
pmc-12963403.creator: Zixuan Cao, Xueli Peng, Di Zhang, Piyu Zhou, Li Kang, Hao Chi, Ruitao Wu, Zhiyuan Cheng, Yao Zhang, Jiaxing Dai, Yanchang Li, Lijin Yao, Xinming Li, Yaoyu He, Jinghan Yang, Haipeng Wang, Ping Xu, Yan Fu
pmc-12963403.description: Despite the recent advancements driven by deep learning, de novo peptide sequencing is still constrained by incomplete peptide fragmentation and insufficient protein digestion in current single protease-based proteomic experiments. Here, we present a software system, named DiNovo, for high-coverage and high-confidence de novo peptide sequencing by leveraging the complementarity of mirror proteases.

pmc-13018155.title: Niche adaptation of particle-associated ammonia-oxidizing archaea sustains nitrification under marine deoxygenation
pmc-13018155.creator: Li Li, Duo Zhao, Rui Du, Kai Tang, Yao Zhang
pmc-13018155.description: Marine deoxygenation is restructuring coastal microbial niches and metabolic networks, with cascading effects on biogeochemical cycles, a key component of which is the nitrogen cycle. Particles constitute a critical ecological interface that mediates microbial niche partitioning and oxygen-sensitive balance between nitrogen loss and retention in deoxygenating coastal waters.

pmc-13064408.title: Mitigating the harmful consequences of arsenic on celosia plants via the use of GABA
pmc-13064408.creator: Amr S. Mohamed, Asmaa E. Abd Elhafez, Mayada M. N. Ahmad
pmc-13064408.description: BackgroundArsenic (As) is a highly toxic metalloid that severely disrupts plant growth, metabolic function, and productivity by inducing oxidative stress and disturbing nutrient homeostasis. Soil contamination with arsenic severely limits plant growth and reduces the ornamental value of many species. In the present study, Celosia argentea var.

pmc-13159421.title: GatorST: A Versatile Contrastive Meta‐Learning Framework for Spatial Transcriptomic Data Analysis
pmc-13159421.creator: Zhenhao Zhang, Yuxi Liu, Song Wang, Qin Ma, Qianqian Song, Jiang Bian
pmc-13159421.description: Recent advances in spatial transcriptomics (ST) have revolutionized the understanding of cellular functions by providing gene expression profiles with rich spatial context. Effectively learning spatial representations is essential for downstream analyses and requires robust integration of spatial and transcriptomic information.

pmc-13292663.title: Impact of PVM/MA Copolymer on Dentin Bond Durability
pmc-13292663.creator: Fusun Ozer, Frances Park, Batu Can Yaman, Zeynep Ozkurt-Kayahan, Francis Mante, Markus B. Blatz

pmc-13383709.title: Hexagonal Boron Nitride on Liquid and Single‐Crystal Copper: Operando X‐Ray and Atomistic Insights into Growth and Interfacial Structure
pmc-13383709.creator: Nikoo Ghanadan, Valentina Rein, Hao Gao, Egor Bersenev, Thomas Sarrazin, Manmeet Kaur Sodhi, Bárbara Canto, Irina Snigireva, Nicolas Gauthier, Anastasios C Manikas, Costas Galiotis, Maciej Jankowski, Gilles Renaud, Athanasios Dimoulas, Karsten Reuter, Oleg Konovalov, Hendrik H Heenen, Irene MN Groot
pmc-13383709.description: Two‐dimensional (2D) hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is a key dielectric for van der Waals nanoelectronics, however, its controlled synthesis by chemical vapor deposition remains challenging and poorly understood. In this context, the growth of hBN on liquid metal catalysts is promising, as the atomically flat liquid surfaces are assumed to promote high‐quality 2D growth, an expectation largely informed by graphene.

pmc-13541828.title: Reject common measures like d′ and Corrected Recognition, embrace da: Simulation explorations of single- and multi-point recognition measures of sensitivity
pmc-13541828.creator: Adva Levi, Raz Danino, Caren M Rotello, Yonatan Goshen-Gottstein
pmc-13541828.description: In this article, we address the high prevalence of false discoveries in recognition memory research. Using Monte Carlo simulations, our goal was to find a valid measure of performance that reliably separates the contribution of sensitivity (accuracy) from that of bias.

uslaw-cfr-t20-s418-3320.title: 20 C.F.R. § 418.3320 — How do we count your earned income?
uslaw-cfr-t20-s418-3320.creator: Social Security Administration
uslaw-cfr-t20-s418-3320.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 20 (Employees' Benefits), Part 418 (Medicare Subsidies). We count net earnings from self-employment.
